name: plasma_fire
title: Heavy plasma launcher

request.text: One heavy sci-fi plasma cannon shot at the very start. Huge low-mid electromagnetic THWUMP, vicious bright ion crack, thick tearing electrical texture and short descending resonant tail. Physical cinematic game sound, centered punch and wide electrical aftermath, then silence. No charging intro, thin cartoon pew, repeated shots, music, speech or ambience.

purpose: Private audition; not yet approved for game integration.
